quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They give drivers important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a divided roadway ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They give drivers important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk is nearby. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings or symbols. They give drivers important information about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic ahead will be merging.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are near a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then go.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must stop completely and check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that pedestrians cross at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns allowed on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve or a narrow section of road ahead. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready for your brakes to work hard.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow and black markings. It warns you that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from the road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this example, the height is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you that the light will turn red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you of a winding road with curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. The number shown is a speed suggestion for the curve ahead. Slow to this speed or slower to safely navigate the curve.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom. This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that you are leaving a one-way highway. You will soon be driving on a road where traffic goes both directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that wet pavement is ahead and can be slippery and dangerous. Slow down because it will take longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone. Do not pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. If you are in that lane, you will need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where pedestrians cross. Watch for people walking across the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve to the right first, then curve to the left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Wait until it is safe before you go through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work zones. These signs help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Fines for traffic violations may be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
Keep your speed steady and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black letters. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic that may merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
You must yield to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that lets you turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if you can, so merging drivers have a clear space.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange or yellow vests and use paddles and flags to direct traffic safely through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down because a curve is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black letters. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
You can only turn right on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that a side road will cross ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabilities. These spaces are for vehicles with disability license plates or placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers about traffic laws. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. You must come to a complete stop, let other traffic and pedestrians pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign indicates that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that road work is ahead. Stay alert for workers and temporary traffic control devices.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive. You must go the way the arrow points.

questions.question: What word appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does a pentagon-shaped sign indicate?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about a school zone. It tells you that children may be crossing or present in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep downhill section ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending. You will soon be on a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if needed before going forward.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn you of hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You cannot turn your vehicle around at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Slow down and be ready for traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves
There is a sharp curve ahead
The road may be slippery when wet

questions.correctAnswerText: The road may be slippery when wet
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that other vehicles may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road entering from the left

questions.explanation: This sign warns you a yield sign is ahead. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to places where bicycles, animals, and pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What type of condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to what is immediately ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same way will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic to safely merge from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right on a red light if you are careful.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turns.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services, like rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle means yield. Slow down and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at the marked line.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful in wet conditions because the road will be slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop and proceed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when safe.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are always stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws. You must obey them. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must let other vehicles go first.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you that you are near a school. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Drive at normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for permission to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: At railroad crossings, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it is safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangle sign tells you to follow the rule shown. This sign means never pass other vehicles.
